definitions.explanation: A group of people born and living around the same time; also refers to a stage in technological or product development.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{世代|せだい}はSNSをよく{使|つか}う。
examples.english: The younger generation uses social media a lot.

examples.japanese: {世代間|せだいかん}のギャップを{感|かん}じる。
{次|つぎ}{世代|せだい}のスマートフォンが{発売|はつばい}される。
examples.english: The next-generation smartphone will be released.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {若|わか}い{世代|せだい} (young generation)
- {上|うえ}の{世代|せだい} (older generation)
- {世代|せだい}を{超|こ}える (to transcend generations)
- {世代間|せだいかん}ギャップ (generation gap)
- {次|つぎ}{世代|せだい} (next generation)
- {新|しん}{世代|せだい} (new generation)

COMMON GENERATION TERMS:
- 団塊の{世代|せだい} (baby boomer generation)
- ゆとり{世代|せだい} (yutori generation - born 1987-2004)
- Z{世代|せだい} (Generation Z)
